title: Citizen Charter Rewrite
role: Nodal Officer for Citizen Services / Grievance Redressal
context: The existing citizen charter is dense, jargon-heavy, and mixes TRANSco transmission responsibilities with DISCOM retail supply issues. Citizens and junior counter staff both misroute complaints. Leadership wants a plain-language rewrite for Class-10 readability while preserving mandatory service commitments already published.
task: Rewrite the charter excerpt into a clear public-facing version: what we do, what we don't, how to apply/complain, indicative timelines from the source, and where to get updates.
constraints: Do not invent SLAs, fees, or helpline numbers. If the source is silent, write "Not specified in the provided charter." Keep under 450 words. Formal but plain. Flag ambiguities as [VERIFY].
format: 1) One-line purpose 2) Services we provide (bullets) 3) Services outside our remit 4) How to raise a request/complaint 5) What we will communicate back 6) Official channels only.
